summary.text: Brianne Wakefield is the Republican and Conservative Party candidate for New York State Senate District 4 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Her campaign website describes her as a community advocate and faith leader who chairs a Suffolk County subcommittee on human and sex trafficking.

paragraphs.text: According to her campaign website, Wakefield chairs the Human & Sex Trafficking Subcommittee of the Suffolk County Women's Advisory Commission and has served on the Suffolk County Citizens Advisory Board for the Arts.
The site says she and her husband founded WayMaker Church in Bay Shore, that she has hosted foreign exchange students since 2019, and that she homeschools her children.
